test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many people may not find the rewards ______ with the time and effort required.
solution:
The correct answer is **commensurate**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Here, we will learn the meaning of the given word:

 
• **Commensurate: **corresponding in size, importance, quality, etc. 
 
• **Example:** Her
